limitations: The arbitrary-odd formula assumes q<=2n1-3; larger odd gaps and general even gaps q>=6 are not settled. The result concerns the unrestricted-field linear LMD problem. Originality is to the best of our knowledge, with residual terminology risk for the auxiliary graph extremal lemma.
provenance: An exact extremal reduction for codimension-two largest-minimum-distance instances of linear locally recoverable codes, with sharp pair-incidence covering numbers for all feasible odd gaps and the first two positive even gaps.
record_title: Exact codimension-two LRC distance criteria from pair-incidence covers
